metadata.title: Application Programming Interface (API) Knowledge Graph
metadata.description: A detailed, interconnected machine-readable graph of API concepts, categories, specifications, protocols, design principles, security, lifecycle, documentation, operations, history, examples, and legal context.
metadata.relationship_direction: Every relationship is directed from source to target; reciprocal semantics require a separate relationship.

source_basis.title: API encyclopedia article supplied with the request
source_basis.coverage: Definition and purpose; history; library/framework APIs; operating-system APIs; remote APIs; web APIs; design; release policies; stability and deprecation; documentation; copyright dispute; examples and related concepts.

source_basis.title: Expanded general API engineering model
source_basis.coverage: REST constraints, HTTP, schemas, RPC and event-driven APIs, security, resilience, testing, governance, developer experience, operations, compatibility, privacy, and architecture.

metadata.scope_note: This graph expands beyond the supplied article with general API engineering concepts. Legal concepts are high-level and jurisdiction-dependent; this is informational, not legal advice.
